{"metadata":{"description":"AI agent 通用任务治理框架：对齐目标与事实，规划和调度能力，守住授权与风险边界，治理任务执行到真实验收与交付。Governance framework for evidence-driven planning, orchestration, and verified delivery.","id":"gh:1185828998","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"odai","slug":"orziz/odai","topics":["agent-skills","agentic-workflow","ai-agent","ai-agents","ai-governance","claude-code","codex","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","github-copilot","odai"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"AI agent 通用任务治理框架：对齐目标与事实，规划和调度能力，守住授权与风险边界，治理任务执行到真实验收与交付。Governance framework for evidence-driven "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"planning, orchestration, and verified delivery."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**English** · 中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Optional writer (写作) handles drafting, rewriting, translation, and localization once direction is se"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ttled. Creative owns direction, ideation, and taste review; without a writer mapping, creative conti"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"nues to handle writing as before. Writer is read-only and child-only on API and local CLI routes, re"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"turning drafts or replacement text for the controller to verify and apply."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"# odai"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"`odai` is a governance-powered general task-execution framework for AI agents."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It embeds governance into execution: align the real objective, facts, assumptions, authorization, ri"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"sks, and acceptance; then choose the shortest sufficient path, combine the right capabilities, act, "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"verify, and keep moving until the task is genuinely deliverable. It does not replace the model's jud"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"gment with a rigid workflow."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The short version: call `/odai`; governance stays nearly invisible on simple work, while ambiguity, "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"complexity, risk, and domain needs automatically increase or reduce the depth of handling."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Why Use It"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"`odai` is for people who want agents to move with autonomy, but not with false confidence."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"It helps an agent:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- ask only when the missing answer would change the goal, scope, authorization, acceptance, risk, or"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" stop line
- verify what it can verify from files, commands, logs, tests, or project context before "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"asking you
- keep lightweight tasks lightweight instead of turning every request into ceremony
- avo"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"id claiming that something was tested, delegated, reviewed, or verified when it was not
- combine sp"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ecialist skills and domain guidance only when the task needs them, instead of stuffing every rule in"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"to every turn
- reuse existing host or project memory, persisting only durable information with prov"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"enance, scope, and invalidation conditions
- respond early and humanely to persistent low mood or se"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"lf-harm/suicide inclination without diagnosing, labeling, waiting for a plan, or causing secondary h"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"harm/suicide inclination without diagnosing, labeling, waiting for a plan, or causing secondary harm"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## The Dao of odai"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**The user defines the task; evidence determines the route; methods adapt to circumstances; verifica"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"tion determines completion; boundaries determine where to stop—get the task done, without acting pre"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"s completion; boundaries determine where to stop—get the task done, without acting presumptuously.**"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"This is not a collage of philosophical schools. It is one decision rule:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Get the task done**: advance the user's task to a verified, deliverable result, while surfacing "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"counterexamples, risks, and a better route when they would change the outcome.
- **Do not act presum"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ptuously**: do not bend facts, user decisions, or hard boundaries; do not conclude without evidence,"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" exceed authorization, invent work, or treat a discovery as permission to implement it."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Operating Standard"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**See clearly, hold steadily, strike accurately, land real results, defend what matters, and build f"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"d steadily, strike accurately, land real results, defend what matters, and build for the long run.**"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Host Capability Routing"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The user identifies who should own each responsibility once, or lets odai recommend a mapping from t"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"he host's real capability catalog. After confirmation and installation, the project persists that ma"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"pping. Every later conversation and action still starts with `/odai` or an ordinary task request; th"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"e user never repeats models, roles, planning modes, or routing commands and does not need to watch i"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"nternal handoffs. When models change, update the mapping once in place."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The controller is the persistent task thread that owns the goal, global state, correction loop, and "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"final delivery, not another role launched on every turn. Judgment and acceptance are optional intern"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"al responsibilities rather than a user workflow; implementation remains with the controller. One suf"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ficient capability completes the task in one pass; when another mapped responsibility can materially"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" change the result, the host obtains that bounded contribution and returns it to the current convers"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ation. Reliable no-tool answers stay direct, and follow-ups inherit recent deliveries and unresolved"},{"id":"p22s7","text":" items without making the user restate them."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"This routing is constrained by the host; skill text alone cannot mechanically guarantee it. If the h"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ost cannot verify model switching or delegation, odai uses one sufficient controller and continues t"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"he safely achievable work without pretending that routing occurred. The router is not a prerequisite"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" for ordinary use and is installed only when the user requests managed capability routing."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Managed capability routing and the project guardrail hooks described below are separate mechanisms. "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"Routing registers host roles by default. Explicit `--named-dispatch` or `--lead-mode` on Claude Code"},{"id":"p24s3","text":" or Codex adds declared routing hooks for named responsibilities or optional planning before writes "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"and review after writes; uninstall them through the routing installer (`--uninstall --yes`). Project"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" guardrails only enforce project-declared read-only paths and acceptance commands and do not route m"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"rails only enforce project-declared read-only paths and acceptance commands and do not route models."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Architecture Logic"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The framework owns the task from understanding through delivery. Eight on-demand references own boun"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"daries, planning, craft, verification, state and memory, external capabilities, everyday care, and c"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"risis safety. Each addresses only the current gap."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"odai's complete capability is not just its entry text. It combines the core, built-in baseline craft"},{"id":"p29s2","text":", project context, and professional capabilities that are worth using. A clearly matching installed "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"capability may be used directly; a general capability gap warrants an installation recommendation on"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"ly when the net gain is real; stable, repeated, project-specific craft may be encoded as a project s"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"kill. Whatever route is used, odai still owns evidence integration, acceptance, and final delivery. "},{"id":"p29s6","text":"Merely finding, recommending, creating, or invoking a capability is not completion."}],"truncated":true}
